### Goal and user impact
What workflow would this improve?

### Milestone and priority
M0 / M1 / M2 / M3 / M4 / optional M5. Explain any M2 release impact.

### Behavior
Inputs, output, stack/register effects, errors, state/persistence and key mapping.

### Evidence and tests
Expected tests/fixtures and any legal provenance requirements.

### Scope boundaries
Does this require a separate financial, historical or desktop component?
